_what: A summary an AI keeps of one conversation (src/thread-summaries.mjs), so the next AI that opens the thread reads a few lines instead of every message, and knows whether newer messages have come since. Keeping and removing a summary are the store's job (workflow:keep-conversation-summaries); reading one is computation over the record handed in, and its words are rows here.

words.needs_conversation: Name the conversation: conversation_id (and app) as the messages show them.
words.none_yet: No summary is kept for this conversation yet. Read its messages, then keep a summary with workflow:keep-conversation-summaries.
words.stale: {count} newer message(s) since this was written. Read them and keep a new summary with workflow:keep-conversation-summaries.
